# Unemployment Cleaning Script

## Import Raw Data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
csv_path = data_dir / "unemployment_and_income" / "Unemployment2023.csv"
```

```{python}
df_raw = pd.read_csv(csv_path, encoding='latin-1')
```

## Change Granularity

### Split Out Years

```{python}
df_raw[["Attribute", "Year"]] = df_raw['Attribute'].str.rsplit('_', n=1, expand = True)
```

### Create Attribute Columns

```{python}
df_final = df_raw.pivot(
    index = ["FIPS_Code", "State", "Area_Name", "Year"],
    columns = "Attribute",
    values = "Value"
).reset_index()
```

## Clean Columns

### Drop Non-Counties

```{python}
df_final = df_final[df_final['Area_Name'].str.contains('County', na = False)].reset_index(drop=True)
```

### Pad FIPS

```{python}
df_final["FIPS_Code"] = df_final["FIPS_Code"].astype(str).str.zfill(5)
```

### Only Keep Necessary Columns

```{python}
df_final = df_final[['FIPS_Code', 'Civilian_labor_force', 'Employed', 'Unemployed', 'Unemployment_rate', 'Year']]
```

### Update column names

```{python}
df_final = df_final.rename(columns={
    "FIPS_Code": "county_id",
    "Civilian_labor_force": "civilian_labor_force",
    "Employed": "employed",
    "Unemployed": "unemployed",
    "Unemployment_rate": "unemployment_rate",
    "Year": "year"
})
```

### Update column types

```{python}
df_final["civilian_labor_force"] = df_final["civilian_labor_force"].astype(int)
df_final["employed"] = df_final["employed"].astype(int)
df_final["unemployed"] = df_final["unemployed"].astype(int)
df_final["year"] = df_final["year"].astype(int)
```

## EDA

### Summary Statistics
```{python}
df_final.describe()
```

### Example Plots

```{python}
value_cols = ['civilian_labor_force', 'employed', 'unemployed', 'unemployment_rate']
```

```{python}
unemployment_means_year = df_final.groupby('year')[value_cols].mean()
```

#### Average Employment and Unemployment Rates by County Over Time
```{python}
sns.lineplot(unemployment_means_year, x='year', y='civilian_labor_force', label='Civilian Labor Force')

sns.lineplot(unemployment_means_year, x='year', y='employed', label='Employed')

sns.lineplot(unemployment_means_year, x='year', y='unemployed', label='Unemployed')

plt.legend()

plt.title("Average Employment and Unemployment Rates by County Over Time")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Number of People")

ax = plt.gca()
ax.ticklabel_format(style='plain')

plt.yticks(rotation=45)

plt.show()
```

#### Average Unemployment Rate by County Over Time
```{python}
sns.lineplot(unemployment_means_year, x='year', y='unemployment_rate')

plt.title("Average Unemployment Rate by County Over Time")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Unemployment Rate (%)")

plt.yticks(rotation=45)

plt.show()
```

# Export to database

```{python}
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
df_final.to_sql(
    "unemployment",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",
    index=False
)
```
